preprocessing_required: Row median centering followed by row scaling in pheatmap
algorithm: Pearson correlation distance and Average hierarchical clustering
threshold_or_assignment_rule: Hierarchical clustering dendrogram partitioned into Classical (27), Basal (17), and Others (18) based on column order
notes: Guo et al., 2021 excluded LEMD1 due to abnormal expression in their cohort, resulting in a 49-gene signature for their validation. Symbols CTSL2, ANXA8L2, ATAD4, and LOC400573 mapped to CTSV, ANXA8, FLAD1, and TMEM238L respectively.

required_input_scale: Normalized expression (untransformed normalized counts or transcripts per million, rank-based)
algorithm: k-Top Scoring Pairs (k-TSP) with penalized logistic regression
threshold_or_assignment_rule: Logistic regression probability > 0.5 is Basal-like, <= 0.5 is Classical. Confidence intervals defined by <0.1 (strong classical), 0.1-0.5 (likely classical), 0.5-0.9 (likely basal), >0.9 (strong basal)
notes: All 16 genes are 100% present in the GSE172356 matrix. Model uses 8 gene-pairs and coefficients. Highly robust to stroma contamination and platform differences.

Lacks a pre-fitted single-sample classifier or exact signature code. Known to be susceptible to stroma contamination (ADEX and Immunogenic subtypes represent stromal/normal signals rather than tumor-intrinsic programs).

expected_classes: Basal-like A, Basal-like B, Classical A, Classical B, Hybrid
